D: Thirteen years after a prom night disaster, a lovesick writer hires a private eye to find the girl, and the private eye falls for her too.
P: Bring out the franks and beans when Warren starts yelling it outside the bathroom.
S: Crumbed risotto balls with a mozzarella middle, like little baseballs

Soften the onion in the butter, stir in the rice, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until creamy and just tender. Stir in the parmesan, season, spread on a tray and chill until firm. Roll into 12 balls, pushing a cube of mozzarella into the middle of each. Roll in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs. Simmer the passata with the garlic and a few basil leaves while the oil heats. Fry the arancini at 180C in batches until deep golden, drain and serve with the marinara and torn basil.
Garlic butter knots with parmesan and marinara. Healy spies on Mary in Miami

Cut the dough into 12 strips, roll each into a rope and tie in a loose knot. Prove on a lined tray for 10 minutes, then bake at 220C until golden. Melt the butter with the garlic for a minute and stir in the parsley. Toss the hot knots in the garlic butter and parmesan and serve with warm marinara.
M: Smoky franks with molasses baked beans. Ted's prom night zipper disaster

Fry the bacon and onion in an ovenproof pot until soft and golden. Stir in the beans, tomatoes, molasses, sugar, mustard, vinegar and water and bring to a simmer. Bake uncovered at 170C, stirring once, until thick and dark. Toss the slaw with the mayo, and grill the franks until blistered. Serve the franks on the beans with slaw alongside.
Crumbed chicken stuffed with ham and Swiss. Puffy ends up in a full body cast

Cut a deep pocket into each breast and fill with a folded slice of ham and cheese. Dust in flour, dip in egg and press into the panko. Brown in the oil on both sides, then bake at 200C until cooked through. Warm the cream with the mustard and season, and steam the beans. Slice the chicken and serve with the beans and the mustard cream.
W: Hair gel meringues with lemon curd
Vanilla meringues with whipped cream and lemon curd, swirled tall

Whisk the whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Whisk in the vinegar, cornflour and vanilla and spoon 8 swirled mounds onto lined trays. Bake at 120C until crisp outside, then turn the oven off and let them cool inside. Whip the cream with a little vanilla, and top each meringue with cream, lemon curd and blueberries.
K: Pineapple and ginger beer punch with rum and lime sorbet. Mary asks Ted to the prom
Stir the rum, pineapple and lime juice in a punch bowl with ice. Top with the ginger beer. Float the sorbet on top and ladle into cups.
